title: space-indented @@ after +++ is E400; the following body lines are E404
notes: §12 item 1: in HEADER the indented-lexeme bullet is tested before the body-looking-after-+++ bullet ('tested before the body-looking rule, so an indented `@@` after `+++` is E400, not E404'). ' @@' is E400; '-a' is then the first body-looking line after +++ and gives E404 once per block.
